text: The earlier radar grep may have failed because of the odd --include=* flag. I'll retry with plain grep -ril, and also list files with radar or feed in their names.
command: cd /work && grep -rIil 'radar' . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; find . -name node_modules -prune -o -iname '*radar*' -print -o -iname '*feed*' -print 2>/dev/null | head -30
